home.heroLede:
A PhD researcher in medical AI.
Still looking up.
bio: I work on medical image analysis, reliable AI, and multi-view learning, with a focus on robust, interpretable methods that fit clinical workflows.
My work spans medical report generation, retrieval-augmented methods, and multi-view anatomical correspondence learning for coronary stenosis reporting.
home.beyond: Forests, flowers, and dark skies keep me grounded and curious.

home.coda:
For thirteen years, Cassini studied Saturn.
Here on Earth, I’m still looking up.

papers.title: MAC-XA: Multi-view Anatomy-Correspondence Fusion for Coronary Stenosis Reporting from X-ray Angiography
papers.abstract: We propose an explicit anatomy-correspondence learning framework for multi-view coronary X-ray angiography report generation. The method aligns anatomically corresponding regions across views and improves structured stenosis reporting by fusing clinically relevant evidence more reliably than implicit attention-based fusion.

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Chest X-ray Report Generation with Clinically Guided Fusion
papers.abstract: This work studies retrieval-augmented report generation for chest X-ray interpretation, with a focus on reducing semantic errors and improving clinical faithfulness in generated reports.

papers.title: Legal Document Summarization with Domain-Aware Language Modeling
papers.abstract: We study domain-aware summarization for legal documents and investigate how task-specific modeling choices can improve summary quality and faithfulness in specialized domains.

bottles.text:
If you found this bottle, hello.
I built this little corner of the sky to keep the things I love: papers, places, stars, and a farm with a very serious snow leopard cat.
If something here caught your attention, send me a note.

To whoever is reading this at 3 a.m. with a deadline:
the night sky has room for slow journeys. Yours can take its time, too.
Go to sleep soon.

title: Somewhere,
beyond home.
voyager.poem:
She leaves the familiar world behind.
From here, every distant light might be a way home.
voyager.fact: Cassini–Huygens launches from Cape Canaveral, beginning its journey to Saturn.

scene.label: Departure
scene.terrain: Pale regolith and deep impact basins
scene.pose: A still three-quarter profile, hands in pockets.
scene.description: A small, long-haired traveller in a pale blue and lavender jacket looks toward Earth. Pale regolith and deep impact basins. A still three-quarter profile, hands in pockets.

title: A little closer
to the Sun.
voyager.poem:
The golden clouds say nothing.
She borrows a world’s gravity, and carries her solitude farther.
voyager.fact: The first Venus flyby gives Cassini a gravity assist for the long journey outward.

scene.label: Venus I
scene.terrain: Obsidian ridges and golden mineral seams
scene.pose: A gentle upward gaze, weight on the rear foot.
scene.description: A small, long-haired traveller in a pale blue and lavender jacket looks toward Venus. Obsidian ridges and golden mineral seams. A gentle upward gaze, weight on the rear foot.

title: We meet,
to leave again.
voyager.poem:
Some reunions are another kind of goodbye.
Beneath the same clouds, she is no longer the same traveller.
voyager.fact: A second encounter with Venus sends Cassini toward Earth.

scene.label: Venus II
scene.terrain: Broken basalt and a vast shadowed caldera
scene.pose: Leaning against a basalt boulder, ankles loosely crossed and hands in her pockets.
scene.description: A small, long-haired traveller in a pale blue and lavender jacket looks toward Venus. Broken basalt and a vast shadowed caldera. Leaning against a basalt boulder, ankles loosely crossed and hands in her pockets.

title: Everything
we called home.
voyager.poem:
That small blue world holds everyone she has ever known.
She looks back. Then turns toward the stars.
voyager.fact: Cassini flies past Earth for a gravity assist on its way to the outer solar system.

scene.label: Earth
scene.terrain: Silver dust, scattered boulders and terraced craters
scene.pose: Seated on the lunar ledge with both legs resting over the edge, looking back at Earth.
scene.description: A small, long-haired traveller in a pale blue and lavender jacket looks toward Earth. Silver dust, scattered boulders and terraced craters. Seated on the lunar ledge with both legs resting over the edge, looking back at Earth.

title: Even silence
has a gravity.
voyager.poem:
A storm large enough to swallow her entire world.
At the edge of its light, even silence feels immense.
voyager.fact: Cassini passes Jupiter, observing the giant planet alongside the Galileo spacecraft.

scene.label: Jupiter
scene.terrain: Blue-white fractured ice beneath Jupiter’s storms
scene.pose: Leaning against an ice boulder, one knee relaxed and both hands in her pockets.
scene.description: A small, long-haired traveller in a pale blue and lavender jacket looks toward Jupiter. Blue-white fractured ice beneath Jupiter’s storms. Leaning against an ice boulder, one knee relaxed and both hands in her pockets.

title: At the edge
of another world.
voyager.poem:
An ancient moon emerges from the dark.
After years of distance, arrival begins to have a shape.
voyager.fact: Before reaching Saturn, Cassini makes a close flyby of the outer moon Phoebe.

scene.label: Phoebe
scene.terrain: Dark carbon-rich rocks and loose angular gravel
scene.pose: A small profile against the ancient cratered moon.
scene.description: A small, long-haired traveller in a pale blue and lavender jacket looks toward Phoebe. Dark carbon-rich rocks and loose angular gravel. A small profile against the ancient cratered moon.

title: A thousand rings.
One quiet soul.
voyager.poem:
Seven years of travelling, for this single moment of wonder.
Light flows through the rings. She is barely a whisper beneath them.
voyager.fact: Cassini becomes the first spacecraft to enter orbit around Saturn.

scene.label: Arrival
scene.terrain: Dark crystalline cliffs above distant golden valleys
scene.pose: Chin raised a little, one foot resting behind the other.
scene.description: A small, long-haired traveller in a pale blue and lavender jacket looks toward Saturn. Dark crystalline cliffs above distant golden valleys. Chin raised a little, one foot resting behind the other.

title: Some journeys
must part ways.
voyager.poem:
A companion of seven years drifts toward an amber world.
Some goodbyes remain inside every future glance back.
voyager.fact: Huygens separates from Cassini and begins a 20-day coast toward Titan.

scene.label: Huygens
scene.terrain: Silver frost on a dark ledge below an amber world
scene.pose: A calm side-back view, shoulders drawn slightly inward.
scene.description: A small, long-haired traveller in a pale blue and lavender jacket looks toward Titan. Silver frost on a dark ledge below an amber world. A calm side-back view, shoulders drawn slightly inward.

title: Under
an amber sky.
voyager.poem:
Beneath the haze: riverbeds, hills, another horizon.
Perhaps unfamiliar worlds know how to wait, too.
voyager.fact: Huygens lands on Titan: the first spacecraft landing on a world in the outer solar system.

scene.label: Titan
scene.terrain: Terraced rock and pale ice under Titan’s amber light
scene.pose: Seated on a terrace with one knee raised, an arm resting gently across it.
scene.description: A small, long-haired traveller in a pale blue and lavender jacket looks toward Titan. Terraced rock and pale ice under Titan’s amber light. Seated on a terrace with one knee raised, an arm resting gently across it.

title: Beneath the ice,
something stirs.
voyager.poem:
The ice keeps its secrets deep.
Then a breath of water rises, and silence finds an echo.
voyager.fact: A close flyby reveals active fractures and water vapour near Enceladus’s south pole.

scene.label: Enceladus
scene.terrain: Glassy dark ice opposite a luminous fractured moon
scene.pose: Head tilted toward the south-polar light.
scene.description: A small, long-haired traveller in a pale blue and lavender jacket looks toward Enceladus. Glassy dark ice opposite a luminous fractured moon. Head tilted toward the south-polar light.

title: Half in light.
Half in longing.
voyager.poem:
Half snow. Half an almost endless night.
She follows the boundary, and finds her own shadow.
voyager.fact: Cassini observes the striking bright and dark terrain of Iapetus at close range.

scene.label: Iapetus
scene.terrain: Dark crags and white mineral frost opposite Iapetus
scene.pose: Seated on a high boulder, arms loosely around one raised knee.
scene.description: A small, long-haired traveller in a pale blue and lavender jacket looks toward Iapetus. Dark crags and white mineral frost opposite Iapetus. Seated on a high boulder, arms loosely around one raised knee.

title: Time passes.
The light stays.
voyager.poem:
Sunlight slips along the rings like an unopened letter.
On another world, she watches the season turn.
voyager.fact: At equinox, sunlight falls almost along the ring plane, revealing long shadows cast by ring structures.

scene.label: Equinox
scene.terrain: Pale cratered ice beneath the thin ring plane
scene.pose: A subtle upward tilt toward the edge of the rings.
scene.description: A small, long-haired traveller in a pale blue and lavender jacket looks toward Saturn. Pale cratered ice beneath the thin ring plane. A subtle upward tilt toward the edge of the rings.

title: Stay a little.
There is more to see.
voyager.poem:
She once thought arrival would be the ending.
But the seasons of a distant world are worth staying for.
voyager.fact: The Solstice extended mission begins, continuing the study of seasonal changes in the Saturn system.

scene.label: Solstice
scene.terrain: A sharp boundary between dark rock and bright frost
scene.pose: One sneaker rests on a rock, body angled toward Saturn.
scene.description: A small, long-haired traveller in a pale blue and lavender jacket looks toward Saturn. A sharp boundary between dark rock and bright frost. One sneaker rests on a rock, body angled toward Saturn.

title: All of us,
in a point of light.
voyager.poem:
Beyond the rings, home is a single blue spark.
Everyone she misses is somewhere in that light.
voyager.fact: From Saturn’s shadow, Cassini takes an interplanetary portrait that includes Earth.

scene.label: Blue dot
scene.terrain: Charcoal craters in the light of the backlit rings
scene.pose: Seated with bent knees, one hand braced on the rock as she looks toward home.
scene.description: A small, long-haired traveller in a pale blue and lavender jacket looks toward Saturn’s eclipse. Charcoal craters in the light of the backlit rings. Seated with bent knees, one hand braced on the rock as she looks toward home.

title: An ocean,
exhaled into stars.
voyager.poem:
An ocean sends its frozen breath into space.
She leans into the silence, as if listening to another world.
voyager.fact: Cassini passes through the south-polar plume of Enceladus, sampling gas and ice particles.

scene.label: Ice plume
scene.terrain: Pale blue chasms beneath the moon’s south-polar jets
scene.pose: A slight forward lean, with a staggered stance.
scene.description: A small, long-haired traveller in a pale blue and lavender jacket looks toward Enceladus. Pale blue chasms beneath the moon’s south-polar jets. A slight forward lean, with a staggered stance.

title: Closer to
the impossible.
voyager.poem:
Countless pieces of ice become a river of light.
She follows its shore toward one last winter.
voyager.fact: Cassini begins a series of orbits skimming the outer edge of Saturn’s main rings.

scene.label: Rings
scene.terrain: Rounded chalk-white ice blocks and fine regolith
scene.pose: A firmer stance beneath the sweeping ring plane.
scene.description: A small, long-haired traveller in a pale blue and lavender jacket looks toward Saturn & the rings. Rounded chalk-white ice blocks and fine regolith. A firmer stance beneath the sweeping ring plane.

title: Between the rings
and eternity.
voyager.poem:
Again and again, it crosses an untouched silence.
She does not wave. She tries to remember everything.
voyager.fact: Cassini makes the first of 22 Grand Finale dives between Saturn and its rings.

scene.label: Finale
scene.terrain: Slate cliffs and pearl ice pebbles under the immense limb
scene.pose: Feet close together, gaze lifted into the ring gap.
scene.description: A small, long-haired traveller in a pale blue and lavender jacket looks toward Saturn’s ring gap. Slate cliffs and pearl ice pebbles under the immense limb. Feet close together, gaze lifted into the ring gap.

title: You became
part of the sky.
voyager.poem:
The final signal crosses the long dark.
Every time she looks up now, something of it is still there.
voyager.fact: Cassini enters Saturn’s atmosphere, ending its mission. The spacecraft’s journey ends at Saturn.

scene.label: Farewell
scene.terrain: Black stone and glassy edges in the last amber light
scene.pose: Relaxed shoulders and a slightly lowered gaze.
scene.description: A small, long-haired traveller in a pale blue and lavender jacket looks toward Saturn. Black stone and glassy edges in the last amber light. Relaxed shoulders and a slightly lowered gaze.

title: Still looking.
Still becoming.
voyager.poem:
A spacecraft’s journey ends. The looking does not.
She turns toward the deeper universe, and leaves her dreams to the stars.
voyager.fact: This chapter is an imagined continuation for the traveller. Cassini did not leave Saturn; the distant nebula is an artistic vision.

scene.label: Beyond
scene.terrain: Obsidian crystals and pale dunes beneath a vast nebula
scene.pose: Seated comfortably on the crystal ledge, legs loosely folded and shoulders relaxed.
scene.description: A small, long-haired traveller in a pale blue and lavender jacket looks toward The deeper universe. Obsidian crystals and pale dunes beneath a vast nebula. Seated comfortably on the crystal ledge, legs loosely folded and shoulders relaxed.
